package.name: base101_bringup_hw
package.description: Hardware bringup for base101: one launch that starts robot_state_publisher + twist_mux + a host-side EKF + rosboard on the real robot — the drive stack only. The Axon 2 firmware owns the whole control loop itself (locomotion, odometry) over zenoh — there is no ros2_control on the host side. Also owns the RViz-only display launch. Deliberately does NOT depend on base101_slam/base101_nav/robocore_agent — those are separate forge components (base101_autonomy for slam+nav, its own agent component), not launched from here. Not the sim counterpart's argument contract: base101_bringup_gazebo/launch/ sim.launch.py still launches everything including slam/nav/agent from one file, so its args are a superset of this one's.
